selected_gap.title: Voice-to-text field report transcription for mining
selected_gap.pain: High – Contractors and HSE teams spend hours manually writing reports after inspections. Voice data is lost, leading to incomplete records and delayed risk identification.
selected_gap.why_now: Advancements in NLP and mobile edge AI enable real-time, accurate transcription even in low-connectivity mining environments. Existing solutions do not integrate voice with checklist workflows.
selected_gap.evidence_needed: Time-and-motion study comparing manual vs. voice-based reporting; interviews with mine HSE managers about pain points.
selected_gap.risk: Technical – Accuracy in noisy mining environments and Spanish/Portuguese dialects. Competition from generic voice apps entering the space.

idea: MineSafety AI narrows specifically to voice-to-text transcription for mining field safety reports. It instantly converts spoken observations from supervisors and contractors into structured, severity-classified risks with prioritized actions, even in remote offline environments. This eliminates manual report writing, reduces transcription errors, and ensures critical hazards are identified and addressed within the same shift, preventing incidents before they occur.
